stage_a_grounded_agreement_rate.numerator: nodes where all 3 models returned grounded==true AND the LLM judge found semantic agreement
stage_a_grounded_agreement_rate.denominator: all demo-corpus nodes attempted this run
stage_a_grounded_agreement_rate.basis: does NOT require citation verification or a clean adversarial check -- purely: did the 3 models derive the same rule from the cited text, independently.

citation_verification_rate.numerator: nodes where every cited source's quoted_text verified as a substring of the fetched page
citation_verification_rate.denominator: all demo-corpus nodes attempted this run (null/not computed if --skip-citation-check)
citation_verification_rate.basis: mechanical HTTP fetch + substring match, no model involved.

stage_b_parse_success_rate.numerator: nodes where the adversarial call returned parseable edge_cases (not truncated, not empty, no error) -- even after the round-23/24 retry
stage_b_parse_success_rate.denominator: all demo-corpus nodes attempted this run
stage_b_parse_success_rate.basis: an infrastructure/reliability signal, not a gap-count -- a node can parse successfully and still expose real gaps, or fail to parse and expose none we know of.

full_pipeline_clean_pass_rate.stage: all three stages combined -- this is the renamed former 'grounded_agreement_rate' (round 26; the old name was found to be mislabeled relative to its own definition, see docs/DEBT_PROJECT_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC.md S4's round-24 entry)
full_pipeline_clean_pass_rate.denominator: all demo-corpus nodes attempted this run
full_pipeline_clean_pass_rate.basis: CLEAN-PASS = LLM-judged semantic agreement across all 3 grounded derivations AND all citations live-verified AND no adversarial gap found AND the adversarial check itself parsed successfully (round 26 -- a Stage B parse failure no longer silently reads as "no gaps", see spec S4). Numeric fingerprint is a secondary diagnostic only as of 2026-08-26 round 3, not part of this basis either.

grounded_agreement_rate.note: Deprecated alias for full_pipeline_clean_pass_rate (round 26), kept only so anything still reading this exact key doesn't break. This name was found to be mislabeled -- it was never actually a Stage-A-only measure despite the name. Use full_pipeline_clean_pass_rate (the honest name for the same number) or stage_a_grounded_agreement_rate (genuinely Stage-A-only) going forward.

scenario_pass_rate.stage: scenario level (depends on multiple nodes' CLEAN-PASS status)
scenario_pass_rate.numerator: concept-demo scenarios where every node_id they depend on is CLEAN-PASS this run
scenario_pass_rate.denominator: all concept-demo scenarios defined in the scenarios file
scenario_pass_rate.basis: a scenario passes iff every node_id it depends on is CLEAN-PASS in this same run

demo_gate_metrics.note: Per the 2026-08-26 Concept Demo First directive S2: both rates must be >=90% before this demo corpus is shown to ANY audience, including Stage-1.5-style friendlies.
